a: =: PyYAML cannot construct the YAML 1.1 `value` scalar and reports invalid YAML; the loader reads a string
a: <<: the same for the `merge` scalar used as a value
a:\tb: a tab after the colon is a PyYAML scanner error; the loader accepts it
a: b\tc: a tab inside a plain scalar is a PyYAML scanner error; the loader accepts it
a: 2025-1-1: PyYAML reads an unpadded date as a string; the loader reads a date. Lab specs contain no dates
a: 2025-02-30: PyYAML fails on an impossible date; the loader rolls it over. Lab specs contain no dates
a: 2025-13-01: the same for an impossible month
a: !!float 3: an explicit !!float tag on an integer: PyYAML gives 3.0, the loader a string
a: 1\rb: 2: a bare carriage return as a line break: PyYAML reads two keys, the loader fails
? [a, b]\n: c: a complex (non-scalar) mapping key: PyYAML fails to construct it, the loader accepts it
a: |\n text\n more: a block scalar at the very end of a text with no final newline: PyYAML drops the trailing newline of the value, the loader keeps it
